title: miconia secuncaquetana

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Miconia secuncaquetana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
